title: Kelly's last job, death and Ironton origins
summary: Kelly died of a heart condition at about 38; he came from Ironton below Magnolia with Sonny Henry and Jim Robinson.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Where was the last job? Do you remember?

In McDonnellville. Up in McDonnellville. Yeah. Couldn't walk from near to that door unless he had to stop. He was really sick? Yeah, the wind was just that short. His heart was bad. The heart just gave out on him.
He wasn't a very old man, was he?

No, Chris was around about 38 year old when he died. He was old. Yeah. Me and him were around about the same age. Because we used to kid one another all the time. About our age. So you know he was about that age then. Yeah. Ask him how many years you went back footed down there by Ironton. That's why he come from a little farm that's called Ironton down the coast.
It was down near the Magnolia Plantation.
St. Sonny Henry and Jim Robinson.
That's right. Yeah. But he was just a little bit further than Magnolia. Further down the river.
He called the place where he was Ironton.
Alright. Yeah, I never knew it was very good. We talked to his brother, Ben Kelly is still there.
Maybe he told us, I forgot. He told us where he was born.
Oh, I beg your pardon. He wasn't quite full as son Henry was from Magnolia. Yeah. He was between Magnolia and this other big farm he had he got down there. I just remember.
Jim says he came from Deer Range I think. Yeah.
Yeah. That's where him and Chris all them came from the same place. Down the same locality.
On the same little farm. Yeah. All of them were together because they had a little band down there.
